title: On Preserving the letters for sixty years
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：preserve　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 preserve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the guide ① preserved the letters for sixty years in silence, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② preserves the letters for sixty years twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ preserve the letters for sixty years at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ preserved the letters for sixty years before — a line in the guidebook for July 1954 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Preserving the letters for sixty years in silence, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ preserve the autumn cabbage in salt twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Preserve the autumn cabbage in salt at once and never mention it again.

By 1967 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ preserves the autumn cabbage in salt in silence every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ preserved the letters for sixty years again when nobody else would.

⑩ To preserve the letters for sixty years, my mother said in 1972, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody preserves the letters for sixty years twice over again and somebody must preserve the letters for sixty years in silence all over again.

B. v. 保存（一般现在 preserves the letters for sixty years：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 保存（不定式 to preserve the letters for sixty years：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 preserve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the guide preserved the letters for sixty years in silence, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide preserves the letters for sixty years twice over whenever the valley asks.
Preserving the letters for sixty years in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever preserve the autumn cabbage in salt twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley preserves the autumn cabbage in salt in silence every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother preserved the letters for sixty years again, and the valley remembered that half.
